backlogged.summary: reproProgram keeps a quoted first word whole. For example, the repro `"node --token=ABCSECRET" x` records repro_program as `node --token=abcsecret`: argument text from the repro, lowercased so that exact-value redaction no longer matches it. Under shell semantics this is the literal program name, so SC-1 is met as written. Capping repro_program at the first whitespace, or redacting it and cutting it with clip(), would close the gap.
repro_program has no length cap. A long first word with no path separator lands in the event unbounded, unlike the other free-text event fields.
On a critical feature where the evaluator hits an eval_error, the reviewer's security/finding events are still written without `unused: true`.
